checks.name: open: hello, init, ready arrive in order with generation 1
open: keep-awake requested once and the host reply was delivered
open: no CSP violation, console error or page exception
open: every request was served by the bundle policy (no 403/404)
open: loader fetched the WASM through the verified path
open: host preferences applied (dark theme, English) and loader dismissed
interaction: e2 then e4 changes the rendered board
interaction: the board settles (two later captures identical)
suspend: frame loop stops, resume restarts it
resize: landscape canvas matches the viewport and frames continue
back: opens the leave confirmation, dismisses it, opens it again
exit: exactly one exit message, no navigation away
late events: a retired document ignores resume/back and draws nothing
reopen: new generation, fresh ready
checks.note: warm = verified bytes reused from CacheStorage

checks.name: reopen: the board is a new match (differs from the moved position)
dispose: runtime retired, no frames, nothing more sent
failure: a missing WASM shows the recovery overlay and reports failed(runtime)
failure: a WASM whose SHA-256 differs never runs and reports failed(runtime)
failure: a host that never answers the handshake fails closed after 5 s with no game fetch
retry: Try again reloads, re-handshakes with a new generation and starts

frameCadence.note: headless SwiftShader software GL; not a device frame-pacing measurement
